agent.title: Agent status
agent.unknownHint: Agent state unknown. Set up Claude status reporting.
agent.setupHint: Start a new Claude Code session in this terminal with the command below. Copy it, paste it at an idle shell prompt and press Enter. Requires a current Claude Code installation with HTTP hooks.
agent.limitations: New local sessions only, from the first prompt; existing and /resume sessions are not supported yet. “Response ended” does not mean the project is verified. Missing hooks leave the last reported state visible.
agent.remoteHint: Explicit agent status is currently available for local Claude Code sessions only. This remote session has no supported event source.
agent.setupError: Status setup is unavailable. Wait for the local terminal to start and try again. Supported shells: zsh, bash and PowerShell. End an active agent session before switching providers.
agent.codexHint: Requires a current Codex CLI with hooks and Node.js in PATH. Copy this command into this pane at an idle shell. In Codex, review and trust the DM Workspace commands with /hooks, then send your first prompt. Your config and approval policy stay unchanged.
agent.codexLimits: Codex approval waits can remain visible until the response ends. General failures and all user-question tools are not covered by its hooks.

overview.title: Agent overview
overview.hint: All connected agents. Waiting and errors appear first. Select an entry to open its terminal. Status reflects the last reported event.
overview.empty: No agents connected yet. Use Agent in a pane header to start Claude or Codex with status reporting.

workspace.folderRestartConfirm: Restart this workspace in the new folder? The running terminals will be terminated.
workspace.deleteMessage: “{{name}}” will be closed. Any running terminals will be terminated.

account.title: Workspace servers
account.empty: No servers configured yet. Add a DM Workspace Web server below to open remote workspaces.
account.hint: Sessions are stored encrypted on this machine (safeStorage); the token never leaves the app.

appearance.brandDesignHint: Graphite Sand is the DM Apps corporate design — warm sand accents on deep graphite. Black Utility uses pure black with fine hairline controls, Standard a calm dark gray. Terminal themes stay independent.
appearance.backgroundHint: Overrides the selected terminal theme's background. Pick a terminal theme again to reset it.
appearance.opacityHint: Lower opacity reveals the blurred backdrop behind the terminals (macOS).
appearance.workspaceNavigationHint: Choose where workspace switching appears. Only one placement is active at a time.
appearance.clickMovesCursorHint: When on, a plain click moves the cursor in the input line to the clicked spot. Option/Alt+click always does this, regardless of this setting. Off by default.
appearance.fontSizeHint: Applies immediately to all terminals. Running programs stay open.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.alreadyAssigned: {{shortcut}} is already assigned to another action
shortcuts.hint: ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere. On Windows/Linux a plain Ctrl+letter is reserved so the shell keeps Ctrl+C/D/W.

templates.title: Workspace templates
templates.empty: No templates yet — save a workspace layout to reuse it later.

session.title: Terminal session
session.restoreHistoryHint: Restores local layouts and terminal history and starts new shells. Previous programs are not resumed. Remote sessions reconnect to the server. When off, local terminal history is neither saved nor restored.

notifications.showReadyBadgeHint: Counts terminals in inactive workspaces with no new output for at least two seconds. This does not mean their work has finished.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desktopNotificationsHint: Notifies you when output pauses in a terminal you are not viewing. A pause confirms neither completion nor success. Off by default.

busy.title: Output activity
busy.hint: Marks a workspace while one of its terminals produces output. The mark clears after two seconds without output. Silent programs may still be working; waiting programs may redraw their display. This indicator does not detect task completion.
busy.reducedMotion: With reduced motion enabled system-wide, every style shows the quiet ring.

updates.title: Updates
